        if (x == 8) return 5;
        if (x == 7) return 6;

    int length = (int)std::to_string(x).length();

    for (int i = 0; i <= length; i++) {
        sumPowers += p[i];

    int minRes = INT_MAX;
    if (x > sumPowers - x)

    sumPowers -= p[length];
    for (int d = 1; d <= 9; d++) {
        long long tempSum = sumPowers * d;
        int digit = (int) (x / p[length - 1]);
        if (d == digit || d + 1 == digit)
            minRes = std::min(minRes, length * d + recurse(std::abs(tempSum - x), sumPowers));
        sumPowers /= d;
    }
    return minRes;
}
